description.narrative: IFC's investment will help in (a) sustaining over 7,000 jobs in Egypt and creating over 400 jobs in Editas production and supply chain; (b) developing sustainable and efficient supply chains in Egypt, Morocco, and other markets in Africa and MCT regions, as Edita will continue to support and develop distributors and local suppliers of inputs, leading to efficient supply chains in these markets; and (c) IFC expects the Project to increase resilience in the market by building Editas capacity to withstand shocks and stresses from forex shortage and inflation.

The proposed investment is up to US$30 million A-loan and mobilization of up to US$15 million to Edita Food Industries S.A.E. (the Company or Edita Egypt), Edita Participation Cyprus Ltd. (Edita-Cyprus), and Edita Trade and Distribution S.A.E. (the Co-Borrowers). The loan will support Editas (i) capital expenditure requirements in Egypt and Morocco, (ii) working capital requirements, and (iii) potential expansion in Africa and the Middle East regions (Project). The Company has been listed on the Egyptian Exchange (EGX) and the London Stock Exchange (LSE) since 2015.
